secondarysystem/sec-trivia/text:
Sega Saturn is a home video game console.
First released in Japan in November 1994 and discontinued in 2000.
Made by Sega.
About 9.5 million units were sold.
Its library has 1,028 games.
It followed the Sega Genesis and was succeeded by the Dreamcast.
Processors include the SH-2.
